events.name: Bash
events.head: Locate the board probes and recent history
events.input: $ ls workshop-plan/probe-public-board.mjs workshop-plan/probe-board-actions.mjs workshop-plan/tasks/ 2>&1 | head -60; git log --oneline -8 -- workshop-plan/tasks/worker workshop-plan/probe-public-board.mjs workshop-plan/probe-board-actions.mjs 2>&1; head -60 workshop-plan/probe-public-board.mjs

events.name: Bash
events.head: Show pass.py usage and probe sandbox handling
events.input: $ python3 workshop-plan/tasks/pass.py --help 2>&1 | head -40; grep -rn "sandbox\|pass.py rm\|T-000\|--live" workshop-plan/probe-public-board.mjs workshop-plan/probe-board-actions.mjs 2>/dev/null | head -40

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run the public board probe against the live Worker
events.input: $ cd [redacted] && date "+START %Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z" && (node probe-public-board.mjs --live 2>&1 | tail -90); echo "EXIT ${pipestatus[1]}"; date "+END %Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z"

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read the probe's round trip section and actions probe header
events.input: $ grep -n "real round trip" -A 34 probe-public-board.mjs | cut -c1-330; sed -n 1,30p probe-board-actions.mjs | cut -c1-260

events.name: Bash
events.head: Fetch the old GitHub Pages board address to check forwarding

events.name: Bash
events.head: See how the probe sends a note, and which background jobs are running
events.input: $ sed -n 60,82p probe-public-board.mjs | cut -c1-420; ls ~/.config/tantra/ | grep -i board; launchctl list | grep -i tantra; lsof -iTCP:8899 -sTCP:LISTEN -n -P | tail -2; grep -n "def cmd_import\|def import_\|15" tasks/pass.py | head -20

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read the send selector and write a timing script

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check how the runner treats probe notes

events.text: Probe notes are auto-acked regardless of task, so a timed note is safe. Running the real-browser timing test and the forward check.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Send a real note from the public board and time its arrival in the Mac inbox

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run the board actions probe on the local board
events.input: $ date "+START %Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z"; node probe-board-actions.mjs 2>&1 | tail -75; echo "EXIT ${pipestatus[1]}"; date "+END %Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z"

events.name: Bash
events.head: Re-run the actions probe into a log and show the failures
events.input: $ node probe-board-actions.mjs > /tmp/t322-actions.log 2>&1; echo "EXIT $?"; grep -n "FAIL\|FAILED\|sandbox\|cleanup" /tmp/t322-actions.log; wc -l /tmp/t322-actions.log; head -30 /tmp/t322-actions.log | cut -c1-300

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check for GitHub assertions in the actions probe and run it a third time
events.input: $ grep -n "github\|popup\|pageerror\|no JS errors" probe-board-actions.mjs | cut -c1-240; node probe-board-actions.mjs > /tmp/t322-actions3.log 2>&1; echo "EXIT $?"; grep -n "FAIL\|cleanup" /tmp/t322-actions3.log

events.name: Bash
events.head: Show the probe lines to extend and current changes
events.input: $ sed -n 32,37p probe-board-actions.mjs | cut -c1-260; sed -n 244,248p probe-board-actions.mjs | cut -c1-200; git status --short -- . | head -20

events.name: Bash
events.head: Add a no-GitHub assertion to the actions probe and re-run it

events.text: All four checks pass now; cleaning up probe leftovers and committing.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check for leftover sandbox tasks and unprocessed probe notes

events.name: Bash
events.head: Acknowledge probe notes and commit the probe change

events.name: Bash
events.head: Set reviewers, log the results on T-322, ack the note and commit

events.name: Bash
events.head: Acknowledge the leftover probe notes and commit

events.text: T-322 stays in review: all four Done-when checks pass on the hardened build (live probe clean, a real note reached the Mac inbox in 2.6 s, the old github.io address forwards to the Worker, no action opens GitHub), with one intermittent miss — the first of four `probe-board-actions.mjs` runs showed 2 failures that did not repeat in three clean runs. No Worker redeploy was needed; the actions probe now asserts no GitHub request or new tab (commit a16ea80), and Bharath is added as a reviewer alongside Adi.
